Indicator 4a2 evaluates the quality of long-term cardiovascular care by measuring the proportion of patients with atrial fibrillation and a clinical indication for anticoagulation who are actively receiving the treatment two years after their index date [^src1]. The national standard sets a target of at least 90% for this metric [^src1]. 

In the 2021/22 reporting period, the national average for [[danmark|Danmark]] was 88.6%, meaning the country as a whole missed the 90% benchmark [^src1]. At the regional level, only [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] (91.1%) and Region Midtjylland (90.4%) successfully met the national standard [^src1]. The remaining regions fell short, with Region Syddanmark at 88.3%, Region Sjælland at 88.0%, and [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] at 86.9% [^src1].

Performance varied significantly across local health clusters. The highest-performing cluster was [[sundhedsklynge-bornholm|Sundhedsklynge Bornholm]], which achieved a 93.8% treatment rate [^src1]. Other clusters meeting or exceeding the 90% target included Randersklyngen (91.6%), Midtklyngen (91.1%), and Klynge NORD (90.6%) [^src1]. Conversely, the lowest-performing areas were [[sundhedsklynge-syd|Sundhedsklynge Syd]] at 84.3% and [[sundhedsklynge-byen|Sundhedsklynge Byen]] at 86.6%, both missing the target by a wide margin [^src1].

Looking at historical trends, the national average showed slight fluctuations, rising from 88.4% in 2019/20 to 89.6% in 2020/21, before dipping to 88.6% in 2021/22 [^src1]. Some clusters experienced notable volatility. For instance, [[sundhedsklynge-bornholm|Sundhedsklynge Bornholm]] saw a sharp improvement, jumping from 90.0% in 2020/21 to 93.8% in 2021/22 [^src1]. In contrast, [[sundhedsklynge-syd|Sundhedsklynge Syd]] experienced a significant decline, dropping from a near-target 89.6% in 2020/21 down to 84.3% in 2021/22, making it a distinct outlier in year-over-year performance degradation [^src1]. Similarly, Sundhedsklyngen Holbæk fell from 90.3% in 2019/20 to 86.7% in 2020/21, and only marginally recovered to 87.9% in 2021/22 [^src1].

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner andelen af patienter med atrieflimren og indikation for antikoagulationsbehandling, der modtager behandling 2 år efter indeksdato, på regions- og sundhedsklyngeniveau for Danmark i 2021/22 samt tidligere år, og viser, at flere regioner og klynger opfylder den nationale standard på ≥ 90%, men at Sundhedsklynge Syd har den laveste andel på 84,3%.
